says: check.yaml's typecheck-job tsc cache path lists (restore and save, lines 383 to 392) have no `kalfa/*/node_modules/.cache/tsc` entry, so once pnpm-workspace.yaml lists `kalfa/*` the workflow-lint guard fails.
proof: With `- kalfa/*` added to pnpm-workspace.yaml's packages, `node .github/ci/workflow-lint.ts` prints `check.yaml: the tsc cache restores and saves node_modules/.cache/tsc in each pnpm-workspace.yaml package glob, in its order` and `workflow-lint: 1 errors`; it passes without that line. The check is .github/ci/workflow-lint/caches.ts:168-172.
cost: CI's workflow-lint step is red for any pull request that adds the `kalfa/*` workspace line until check.yaml lists the glob.
